samples.summary: New empty-group drop is only exercised via the dropped-image path; the chart and zero-children triggers named in the code comment are untested
samples.evidence: src/export/pptx/group.ts:117-122 justifies the new `if (!children) return ''` guard with two triggers: "dropped images, Phase-2 charts", plus it implicitly also covers a group authored with `data.children: []`. Both new tests (group.test.ts:117 and :135) drive the guard exclusively through `resolveImageRId: () => null`. There is no test for a group whose only child is a `chart` element (the existing chart test at :38 pairs the chart with a surviving shape, so the group is NOT emptied) and none for `data.children: []`. The core behavior IS meaningfully covered by the image case (same code path), so this is breadth, not fake coverage.

samples.summary: No test covers the new drop reaching the actual production caller (slide.ts spTree) — e.g. a slide whose only element is an emptied group
samples.evidence: slide.ts:157 (`slide.elements.map((el) => elementToXml(el, ctx)).join('')`) is the only production caller of the changed code, and slide.test.ts:8 hard-codes `resolveImageRId: () => 'rId1'`, so no slide-level test ever sees a `null` rId.
